text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Knightmon] in their texts would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by placing this Digimon as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card, they don't leave.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)

qa.answer: No, only the Digimon where this card was placed as the bottom digivolution card is prevented from leaving the battle area.
qa.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my other Digimon with [Knightmon] in their text would leave the battle area by my opponent's effects at the same time, and I place this Digimon as 1 of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card, are all of my other Digimon with [Knightmon] in their text prevented from leaving the battle area?

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Knightmon] in their texts would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by placing this Digimon as any of those Digimon's bottom digivolution card, they don't leave.
